adds.rationale: NuScale's small modular reactor design became the first SMR ever certified by the NRC on July 29, 2022, a concrete regulatory milestone marking the buildup phase of the nuclear wave the profile names as a likely next wave, and the stock has traded on NYSE since its May 2022 SPAC listing so it clears the liquidity/history bar.

news_evidence.summary: NRC Commission votes to certify NuScale's 50-MWe SMR design, the first small modular reactor design ever approved for use in the US
NuScale Power completes business combination with Spring Valley Acquisition Corp., begins trading on NYSE as SMR

removes.rationale: AAPL is the weakest wave-thesis fit on the current watchlist (a general-market mega-cap hardware holding, not aligned with the named AI/defense/rockets/nuclear waves), and Q3 news shows a concrete demand deceleration -- Apple scrapped plans to boost iPhone 14 production after soft launch demand, on top of an earlier hiring slowdown tied to recession fears -- so the slot is better used for the emerging nuclear buildup candidate.

news_evidence.summary: Apple tells suppliers to pull back from a planned 6-million-unit iPhone 14 production increase after first three days of China sales ran 11% below the iPhone 13 launch
Apple reportedly plans to slow hiring and spending growth in some divisions amid recession fears

rationale_overall: Net effect: swap AAPL (a general-market mega-cap with no clear tie to the profile's named waves, and now showing a Q3 demand deceleration in iPhone 14 sell-through plus an earlier hiring slowdown) for SMR, which captures the nuclear wave's July 2022 regulatory buildup signal (first-ever NRC SMR design certification) that the profile flags as a likely next wave for early exposure. MSFT and NVDA are kept as the AI-wave core (NVDA's late-August China export-license headwind is a specific commercial friction, not a thesis breach, so it stays); LMT is kept for the defense/geopolitical wave; RKLB is kept for the rockets/spacecraft wave on continued execution -- record Q2 revenue reported Aug 11, accelerated Neutron engine-test siting, and an on-track path to a US Wallops launch. Post-change watchlist (MSFT, NVDA, LMT, RKLB, SMR) stays at the 5-ticker cap with clean bucket diversity: 2 AI, 1 defense/geopolitical, 1 rockets_spacecraft, 1 nuclear.
